name: opencode-cloud
description: Experiment running the OpenCode web UI inside Cloudflare Sandbox

scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:prepare && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:prepare: pnpm run build:web && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler d1 migrations apply opencode-cloud --remote
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:web && wrangler d1 migrations apply opencode-cloud --local && wrangler dev
scripts.start: pnpm run build:web && wrangler d1 migrations apply opencode-cloud --local && wrangler dev
scripts.types: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler types --strict-vars=false && pnpm run types:host
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p web && tsc --noEmit -p host
